title: Reduction commutes with a generic fibre
statement: Let $h:Z\to T$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $\eta\in T$ be the generic point of an irreducible component [def-weil-irreducible-components]. The canonical map from $(Z_{\mathrm{red}})_\eta$ to $Z_\eta$ identifies $(Z_{\mathrm{red}})_\eta$ with $(Z_\eta)_{\mathrm{red}}$ as schemes over $\kappa(\eta)$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]. No finite type, reducedness, or flatness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: For a reduced affine source Spec B over Spec A and a minimal prime p of A, use Ideal.Fiber.algEquivQuotient to identify the fibre ring with L/J, where L is the localization of B at the image of A minus p, and J is the image of the maximal ideal of A_p. Ring.KrullDimLE.of_isLocalization gives dimension zero for A_p, and Ring.KrullDimLE.isNilpotent_iff_mem_maximalIdeal shows that this maximal ideal consists of nilpotents. Their images in the reduced localization L vanish. Thus J is zero and L/J is reduced. This works also for the zero localization.

The canonical affine fibre comparison Spec.fiberToSpecResidueFieldIso transfers the ring calculation to scheme-theoretic fibres of affine morphisms. Pull back an affine cover of an arbitrary reduced source to its fibre; pullback symmetry and pullbackRightPullbackFstIso identify each chart with the fibre of the corresponding affine source chart. IsReduced.of_openCover then proves reducedness of the fibre over an affine base.

Choose an affine base chart containing eta. The closure of its lift is an irreducible component, by preimage_mem_irreducibleComponents for the open embedding, so its corresponding prime is minimal. Base changing the source to this open preserves reducedness. The residue-field map of an open immersion is an isomorphism; isPullback_fiberToSpecResidueField_of_isPullback therefore identifies its fibre with the original fibre. Hence the generic fibre of any reduced scheme is reduced.

Construct the canonical map v from the fibre of Z_red to the fibre of Z using pullbackRightPullbackFstIso. It is the base change of the surjective closed immersion Z_red to Z, hence a surjective closed immersion itself, with the prescribed projection equations. Its source is reduced by the preceding steps. Scheme.Hom.liftNilradical factors it through the reduction of the target. This factor is a closed immersion since its composite with the reduction inclusion is; it is surjective since that composite is surjective and the reduction inclusion is injective. A surjective closed immersion into a reduced scheme is an isomorphism. Take this isomorphism and obtain both projection identities from its factorization equation.
